name: WearTryOn
tagline: WearTryOn – Lay a new garment over the photo you bring
description: WearTryOn drapes a garment or a full outfit of up to three pieces on your photo while face, hair, pose, and background stay in place. Sample previews with Ava and Leo need no sign in. Welcome credits start at ten, and check-in adds two more each day. Plus is $19 a month, or $11 a month billed yearly ($132), and grants 1,500 credits. Pro is $39 a month, or $23 a month billed yearly ($276), grants 5,000 credits, and allows commercial use. Packs start at $6 once for 300 credits and never expire. Watermarks may appear on free or unsigned results, and any purchase clears them.
